The Founder

My Story

I spent years building a life abroad, raising a family, and pursuing the future I believed I was meant to have. Then life took an unexpected turn.

After making the difficult decision to leave my marriage, I found myself rebuilding from the ground up. What many people didn’t see were the fears, the heartbreak, and the quiet moments of doubt that came with that process.

Sharing my story became part of my healing. Attract Align Empower™ was born from that realization.
